registered_design: One fixed BOS/EOS alternative, no parameter sweep or unknown-page access for model design. Previous E036 short-control TUNNELNG->TUNNELEA failure is known, so this is a targeted general repair tested on previously inspected regression and excluded-source texts, not blind model selection.
training: Pinned pg2944.txt, split tokens from heldout_language.corpus; chaptersI,III,IV,V,VI,VII,VIII,IX only. II excluded, X/XI/XII excluded from fitting. No LP words/counts added.
model: Order4 hierarchical Dirichlet conditional events over29 runes plus EOS=30; BOS=29 only in context, three initial BOS per word. alpha0.5,strength5. Count all word-token events including EOS and all suffix context lengths0..3. Q(w) product including EOS. Q permits empty emissions; full word distribution (count(w)+20*Q(w))/(total_word_tokens+20). Observed segments nonempty. Sum log probabilities divided by rune count. No cross-word context, apostrophe joining, edge fallback or spelling correction.
diagnostic: E080 evaluates truth and every406 single symbol-transposition neighbor of each regression; ignore swaps leaving plaintext unchanged for ranking gate. Compare previous E036 selected wrong plaintext as a preserved diagnostic, never relabel old results.
heldout: Same18 E036 windows: first6 paragraphs with at least20 words in each of X,XI,XII, first20 words. Fresh20 single-position nonzero mutations per window, Random3304080. Known inspected text, fresh draws. Compare unchanged E036 word score to new score on identical samples.
null: 19 independent exact-count shuffles per heldout window, fixed segment endpoints, seed3302080+100*window_index+replicate. Both scalar objectives and vector implementation checked. Language diagnostic only, no optimized ciphertext test or p-value; not used to select parameters.
arithmetic: All regression-neighbor and heldout sequence scores compared between vector and scalar implementations within1e-9; unit tests cover independent event counts, conditional normalization, EOS, and batch scores.
gate: All three true regression texts strictly exceed every distinct one-swap neighbor by1e-12; new heldout strict-win rate>=0.95 and no loss vs old exceeding0.01; scalar/vector agreement. These local checks do not establish global optimizer recovery.
followup: Only on E080 gate, preregister E081 fresh-permutation blind-key search on3regressions+6excluded Emerson windows, plus3 full-search diagnostic nulls for shortest regression. Unchanged E036 starts/warmup, then40 all406-swap sweeps using new word score. All controls exact on observed symbols before separately registered unknown scan with full matched nulls and selection correction.
limits: General substitution heuristic; not a29! exhaustive search. Page edges assumed word endpoints. No historical text decryption inferred from synthetic substitution recovery. Failed gate blocks unknown search; do not tune against this outcome in the same batch.
